_doc: Per-minor @replen/mcp release highlights, keyed 'major.minor'. The in-product upgrade nudge (src/lib/client-version.ts) composes its 'what's new' line from this — naming what a stale client is missing. Managed by scripts/release-mcp.mjs, which requires a highlight on every minor/major bump; patch releases get no entry. Don't hand-edit except to fix wording. The '1.0' baseline (Leaps/Recall/Atlas) has no entry on purpose — there's no 'update to 1.0' to advertise.
1.1: a tighter, clearer toolset (the 23 MCP tools consolidated down to 14)
1.2: vault-aware leaps — it now reads your Obsidian/Graphify wikilinks to connect work across your repos
1.3: Atlas Carts: pull your saved, filtered views (blind spots, stale deferrals, keystones) inline with replen_cart
